    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Age
    Represents the age (era) of a card in the game deck.
    Artist
    An Artist character card.
    Board
    Represents the game board, holding the card rows (tribe and building), the offer field (totem placement spaces), and utility methods for game flow.
    BoardConfiguration
    Utility class for constructing board objects from JSON configuration nodes.
    BoardSnapshot
    JSON-serializable snapshot of Board.
    BoardSnapshot.SpaceSnap
    State of a single offer space.
    BoardSpace
    Represents a single offer-field space on the board where a player can place their totem.
    Bot
    Server-side bot that replaces a disconnected player.
    Builder
    A Builder character card.
    BuildingCard
    Abstract base class for all building cards.
    BuildingEachTurn
    A building card that grants a persistent per-turn or permanent bonus effect.
    BuildingEachTurnType
    Identifies the per-turn effect provided by a BuildingEachTurn card.
    BuildingEnd
    A building card that grants bonus prestige points at the end of the game.
    BuildingEvent
    A building card that reacts to a specific event type during event resolution.
    Card
    Abstract base class for all cards in the game.
    CardRef
    Minimal card reference: unique card ID and whether the card has already been drawn.
    CharacterCard
    Abstract base class for all character (tribe) cards.
    CharacterType
    Identifies the type of a character card.
    ClientLauncher
    Unified client entry point — single launcher for both TUI and GUI.
    ClientLauncherGUI
     
    ClientModel
    Client-side model.
    CLIView
    CLI view — transport-agnostic.
    Collector
    A Collector character card.
    CombinedServer
    Unified server entry point.
    DatabaseManager
    Singleton JDBC manager for the FA1 global leaderboard.
    Deck
    The main card deck for the game.
    DeckConfiguration
    Factory class for creating card instances from JSON configuration nodes.
    EventCard
    Abstract base class for all event cards.
    EventType
    Identifies the type of an event card.
    Game
    Core game model implementing all game-flow logic for a single match of Mesos.
    GameActions
    Defines all valid game actions that mutate the model.
    GameController
    Server-side MVC controller
    GameObserver
    Server-side model observer.
    GameScreen
     
    GameServerProxy
    Transport-agnostic interface for all client → server actions.
    GameSnapshot
    JSON-serializable snapshot of the entire game (Game).
    GameState
    Represents the current phase of the game.
    GUIView
    JavaFX-based GUI view that implements ModelObserver.
    Hunt
    The Hunt event card.
    Hunter
    A Hunter character card.
    InventionType
    Identifies a specific invention token that can be owned by a player.
    Inventor
    An Inventor character card.
    LobbyManager
    Manages N simultaneous lobbies (GameController instances).
    LobbyManager.LobbyInfo
    Serialisable snapshot of an active lobby sent to clients.
    MessageType
    Exhaustive list of message types exchanged over the TCP socket.
    ModelObserver
    Client-side Observer interface.
    MusicPlayer
    Utility class for background music playback in the GUI.
    NetworkMessage
    Single message unit exchanged over the TCP socket.
    NetworkUtils
    Shared network utilities.
    OrderBlock
    Represents a single slot on a TurnOrder tile.
    PersistenceManager
    Manages saving and restoring games to/from disk (Persistence feature).
    Pictures
    The Cave Paintings event card.
    PingPongManager
    Manages a PING/PONG heartbeat for a single TCP connection. ── Logic ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── Every PING_INTERVAL_MS milliseconds the scheduler fires: 1.
    Player
    Represents a player in the game, holding their resources, cards, flags, and identity.
    PlayerSnapshot
    JSON-serializable snapshot of a Player.
    RankingEntry
    Immutable DTO representing one row of the global historical leaderboard.
    Ritual
    The Shamanic Ritual event card.
    RmiClient
    RMI client adapter.
    RmiServer
    RMI server.
    Shaman
    A Shaman character card.
    SocketClient
    Client-side Socket connection manager. ── Responsibilities ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── 1.
    SocketClientHandler
    Handles one Socket client connection on the server side.
    SocketServer
    TCP Socket server.
    SocketServerProxy
    Client-side proxy that implements GameServerProxy over a TCP socket.
    Sustenance
    The Sustenance event card.
    Totem
    Represents a player's totem piece used to claim offer spaces on the board.
    TotemColor
    Represents the color of a player's totem, uniquely identifying each player on the board.
    TribeCard
    Abstract base class for all tribe-row cards.
    TurnOrder
    Represents a turn-order tile, which contains a sequence of OrderBlock slots where players place their totems to determine initiative and receive food bonuses or maluses.
    TurnOrderSnapshot
    JSON-serializable snapshot of TurnOrder.
    VirtualServer<V>
    Client-to-server action interface, parameterised by the transport-specific VirtualView type.
    VirtualServerRmi
    RMI-specific server interface exposed by the server to its clients.
    VirtualView
    Server-to-client callback interface.
    VirtualViewRmi
    RMI specialisation of VirtualView.
